scope: 336 actual 8x8 opening-board element screenshots: 21 themes × 8 piece surfaces × High visibility on/off. The square check compares rendered empty light/dark squares. The silhouette check measures best local edge contrast in the narrow dual-keyline band against each occupied playable square; painted-face contrast remains a diagnostic. Contact sheets retain visual context. Does not certify flags, crowns, move/capture animations or reduced motion.
viewport: isolated Chromium, board element rasterized at 514×514 including 1px frame; inner 512×512 board sampled.
sampling: For every case, compare all rendered empty light/dark square-center patches; square acceptance uses their 10th percentile to discount individual antialiasing/texture outliers and is cross-checked against every CSS gradient endpoint. For each of 24 opening discs, compare the 3×3 median face-center patch with an empty playable-square center on the same column. At each of 32 perimeter angles, sample median RGB patches at 0.395–0.465 cell radii and record the best contrast against that same dark playable square at 0.47 cell radii.
